arguments.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean start, but it currently feels quite sparse — there's just a short intro and your email. I'd suggest adding a bit more about yourself (your background, interests, or work), maybe a photo, and some links to projects or social profiles. Also, you might want to double-check the email section since it appears to repeat the same address twice. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a lovely start, and I love that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby — that's a great theme to build on! Right now the content is quite minimal, so I'd suggest adding posts about your hiking adventures (trails, photos, tips), an "About me" section, and maybe a way for readers to subscribe or comment. That would make the blog more engaging and give visitors a reason to return. Keep it up!
